model: claude-sonnet-5 (Claude Code session, direct image read, no Anthropic Messages API call)
method: Revised 2026-07-23: the source PDF (inputs/incoming/DEICO_DE3000_Technical_Drawing.pdf) was read directly inside a Claude Code conversation, using both the rendered page image and the PDF's embedded text layer (this differs from the original 2026-07-09 pass, which used the rendered image only; see warnings history in git for the transcription slip that motivated the change). A raw JSON response was hand-written against the rules in src/technical_drawing_parser/extraction/prompt.py (build_vlm_prompt) and the schema in product.py, then passed through the actual src/technical_drawing_parser/extraction/validator.py (parse_product_json_response) and src/technical_drawing_parser/json_format.py (format_json_compact) so the final shape matches what the real pipeline would produce from that raw response. No API request was made, so this run has no token/API cost beyond the conversation itself and no raw_response.txt equivalent. Because text-layer access is not available to the real image-only VLM call, this file is a hand-derived reference for checking prompt/schema correctness, not a simulation of real Anthropic/Ollama image-only extraction quality (see outputs_claude_code_blind_test/ for that).
purpose: Comparison baseline against outputs_claude_sonnet_test/products/deico_de3000.json (produced via the Anthropic API) without spending API budget or overwriting that result.
